parameters.query: INSERT INTO match_runs(batch_id) VALUES ($1::uuid) RETURNING run_id, started_at, batch_id;
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid) AS users_in_batch, (SELECT count(*) FROM loan_products WHERE is_active) AS active_products;

UPDATE match_runs SET status='success', finished_at=now(), users_in_batch=0, active_products=$2, pairs_considered=0, after_stage1=0, after_stage2=0, llm_pairs=0, matches_written=0 WHERE run_id=$1 RETURNING *;

WITH b AS (SELECT user_id, email, monthly_income, credit_score, employment_status, age FROM users WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid), p AS (SELECT product_id, lender_name, product_name, interest_rate_min, interest_rate_max, min_monthly_income, min_credit_score, max_credit_score, min_age, max_age, employment_types, eligibility_text, source_url FROM loan_products WHERE is_active) SELECT b.user_id, b.email, b.monthly_income, b.credit_score, b.employment_status, b.age, p.product_id, p.lender_name, p.product_name, p.interest_rate_min, p.interest_rate_max, p.min_monthly_income, p.min_credit_score, p.max_credit_score, p.min_age, p.max_age, p.employment_types, p.eligibility_text, p.source_url FROM b JOIN p ON (p.min_monthly_income IS NULL OR (b.monthly_income IS NOT NULL AND b.monthly_income >= p.min_monthly_income)) AND (p.min_credit_score IS NULL OR (b.credit_score IS NOT NULL AND b.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score)) AND (p.max_credit_score IS NULL OR (b.credit_score IS NOT NULL AND b.credit_score <= p.max_credit_score)) AND (p.min_age IS NULL OR (b.age IS NOT NULL AND b.age >= p.min_age)) AND (p.max_age IS NULL OR (b.age IS NOT NULL AND b.age <= p.max_age)) AND (p.employment_types IS NULL OR array_length(p.employment_types, 1) IS NULL OR b.employment_status = ANY(p.employment_types));

=WITH incoming AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.matches || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb) AS x(user_id text, product_id bigint, stage text, score numeric, reasons jsonb)), up AS (INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, batch_id, match_stage, score, reasons) SELECT i.user_id, i.product_id, '{{ $('Start Run').first().json.batch_id }}'::uuid, i.stage, i.score, i.reasons FROM incoming i ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id, match_stage = EXCLUDED.match_stage, score = EXCLUDED.score, reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons, is_active = TRUE, updated_at = now() RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE inserted) AS inserted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT inserted) AS updated FROM up;

=WITH incoming AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.llm_matches || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb) AS x(user_id text, product_id bigint, stage text, score numeric, reasons jsonb)), up AS (INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, batch_id, match_stage, score, reasons) SELECT i.user_id, i.product_id, '{{ $('Start Run').first().json.batch_id }}'::uuid, i.stage, i.score, i.reasons FROM incoming i ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id, match_stage = EXCLUDED.match_stage, score = EXCLUDED.score, reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons, is_active = TRUE, updated_at = now() RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE inserted) AS inserted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT inserted) AS updated FROM up;

UPDATE match_runs SET finished_at = now(), status = 'success', users_in_batch = $2, active_products = $3, pairs_considered = $2::bigint * $3::bigint, after_stage1 = $4, after_stage2 = $5, llm_pairs = $6, matches_written = $7 WHERE run_id = $1 RETURNING *;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ok', run_id: $('Start Run').first().json.run_id, batch_id: $('Start Run').first().json.batch_id, matches_written: $('Finish Run').first() ? $('Finish Run').first().json.matches_written : 0 }) }}
